title: acetosa acetosella
intro: Acetosa acetosella, commonly known as the wood sorrel or lesser sorrel, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the family Oxalidaceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and ulcers, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the wood sorrel plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
